title: Surreal Halloween Night
description: A surreal night scene features a large black bird with yellow eyes perched on a cracked green moon, surrounded by a blue robot, a purple ghost, a black furry monster, and a masked snake-like creature on a gnarled tree. Below, a stone table holds scattered cards with eye motifs, set against green hills, a red sun, and a large central eye in the sky.
prompt: A surreal Halloween night scene with a large cracked green moon in a purple sky. A big black bird with yellow eyes and open beak sits on the moon. On a gnarled dark tree branch above are a blue retro robot, a purple ghost with stars, a black furry monster with red eyes, and a purple snake-like creature with a human face mask. Below on green hills is a stone table covered with scattered playing cards featuring eye symbols. A large red eye floats in the sky above a red sun, with small houses in the distance. Ornate decorative border with snakes, eyes, and hands. Dark fantasy illustration style.
